items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: he was what I might say, interested me in playing music, because when I would go to the dances, there's very little dancing I would do, I would listen to his playing.

ctx.x: And we would have our school dances on the roof garden. It was a very lovely place. And in Manuel Perez's band, there was a banjo player named Caffrey.
